summary: Train and deploy a model that distinguishes surgical instruments in live video; the top five models are tested on real surgical footage.
eligibility: Individual entry; 20 places, approval-based. Vision-model skills required, no medical background needed. Age, international admission and fees unstated. NDA and data licence required.
title: XRlabs Real-Time Vision Challenge

prize.description: GBP 1,000 / 600 / 400, a hardware prize and US$100 NVIDIA Brev credits per participant.

notes: Event 24 October, 10:00–19:00 at the London Institute for Healthcare Engineering. Official Luma application page was not found.
Models trained on XRlabs data cannot be published or commercialised and must be deleted after the event.
